spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: Common noun left as Hebrew sólet; the token licenses a Spanish noun for fine flour.
Passive participle licenses mixed/mingled; amasada adds kneading.
Common noun left as Hebrew minjá; the token licenses a Spanish noun for the offering.

notes: Counts, suffixes, silver vessels, weight, and shekel of the holiness match the tokens.
